english_text: All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know the Father, except the Son, and he to whom the Son desires to reveal him.
english:
Understanding grows when insight is shared between those who listen.
True knowledge is offered only to those who are prepared to receive it.
Respectful exchange allows hidden truths to become clear.
spanish:
La comprensión crece cuando el entendimiento se comparte entre quienes escuchan.
El verdadero conocimiento se ofrece solo a quienes están preparados para recibirlo.
El intercambio respetuoso permite que las verdades ocultas se vuelvan claras.
portuguese:
A compreensão cresce quando a percepção é compartilhada entre quem escuta.
O verdadeiro conhecimento é oferecido apenas àqueles que estão preparados para recebê-lo.
A troca respeitosa permite que verdades ocultas se tornem claras.
french:
La compréhension s'accroît lorsque la perception est partagée entre ceux qui écoutent.
Le vrai savoir n'est offert qu'à ceux qui sont prêts à le recevoir.
Un échange respectueux permet aux vérités cachées de devenir claires.
tagalog:
Lumalago ang pag-unawa kapag ang kaalaman ay ibinabahagi sa mga nakikinig.
Ang tunay na kaalaman ay iniaalok lamang sa mga handang tumanggap nito.
Ang magalang na palitan ay nagpapalinaw sa mga nakatagong katotohanan.
swahili:
Ufahamu huongezeka wakati maarifa yanashirikishwa kati ya wale wanaosikiliza.
Maarifa ya kweli yanatolewa tu kwa wale walio tayari kuyapokea.
Mabadilishano ya heshima huruhusu ukweli uliofichwa kuwa wazi.
mandarin_chinese:
当洞见在倾听者之间分享时，理解会增长。
真正的知识只会提供给准备好接受的人。
尊重的交流使隐藏的真理变得清晰。
russian:
Понимание растёт, когда прозрение делится между теми, кто слушает.
Истинные знания предлагаются только тем, кто готов их принять.
Уважительный обмен позволяет скрытым истинам стать ясными.
malayalam:
ആലോചനകൾ കേൾക്കുന്നവരിൽ പങ്കിടുമ്പോൾ ബോധം വളരുന്നു.
യഥാർത്ഥ ജ്ഞാനം സ്വീകരിക്കാൻ സജ്ജമായവർക്കേ മാത്രമേ നൽകപ്പെടൂ.
മാന്യമായ ഇടപാട് മറഞ്ഞ സത്യം വ്യക്തമാക്കുന്നു.
